mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, project_id, min_alert_level, sms_enabled, push_enabled, email_enabled, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, created_at FROM user_project_alert_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, project_id, min_alert_level, sms_enabled, push_enabled, email_enabled, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, created_at FROM user_project_alert_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_project_alert_subscription (user_id, project_id, min_alert_level, sms_enabled, push_enabled, email_enabled, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{minAlertLevel}, #{smsEnabled}, #{pushEnabled}, #{emailEnabled}, #{quietHoursStart}, #{quietHoursEnd}, NOW())
